Short title and commencement

ACT XV OF 1992
ACT XV OF 1992
PASSPORT
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Passport Act, 1974
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 30th July, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 26th
July, 1992, and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.------(1) This Act may be called the Passport (Amendment) Act,
1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 8, Act XX of 1974

ACT XV OF 1992
ACT XV OF 1992
PASSPORT
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Passport Act, 1974
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 30th July, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 26th
July, 1992, and is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 8, Act
XX of 1974.--In the Passport Act, 1974 (XX of 1974), in section 8, in
subsection (2), for the proviso the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"Provided that no such
notice need be given in the case of an order impounding a passport if it is
necessary in the opinion of the Secretary or such other officer to take
immediate action, but an opportunity to show cause against the making of the
order shall be afforded to the person to whom the order relates, within two
weeks from the making of the order."
